value.name: 50' · Marko Livaja v Celtic
value.narrative: Vasilios Lampropoulos: wins the header from a free-kick and nods it on across goal. Marko Livaja: left free in the six-yard box, heads in.

sequence.position: penalty area, from a free-kick delivery
sequence.note: Flicks the free-kick on towards goal.
Unmarked after Hendry is beaten to the ball, heads home from close range.

value.name: 90+8' · Dereck Kutesa v Universitatea Craiova
value.narrative: Niclas Eliasson: whips in a curling cross. Dereck Kutesa: meets it at the back post with a powerful header from close range to make it 2-2.

sequence.note: Delivers a curling cross into the box.
Thumping header from very close range for the equaliser.
